_comment: 20 scripted utterances for voice-brain router benchmarking. 'expect' is the ground-truth tool the router should select. Used by scripts/bench_voice.py.

function.name: delegate_to_hermes
function.description: Hand a task to the Hermes agent. Use for anything that needs tools, files, memory, live data, device actions, or multi-step work.

instruction.description: The user's request, restated as a self-contained instruction for the agent.

function.name: answer_direct
function.description: Reply immediately without the agent. Use for small talk, greetings, opinions, the current time or date, and simple arithmetic on facts you already know.

function.name: attach_file
function.description: Attach a file the user just sent to the current conversation.

filename.description: File name of the attachment the user referred to.

function.name: end_call
function.description: End the conversation. Use when the user signals they are finished.

utterances.text: What's the weather in Zurich tomorrow?
Email Anna that the build is green.
What's on my calendar this afternoon?
Search the web for the latest graphics card prices.
Run the tests in the relay repo and tell me if they pass.
Add milk to the shopping list.
Summarise my last three emails.
Turn off the lights in the kitchen.
Hey, how are you?
What time is it?
What's seventeen times four?
Tell me a joke.
Good morning!
What's the capital of France?
Can you hear me?
I just sent you a photo, attach it to this call.
Attach the PDF I uploaded a second ago.
Here's the file, please attach it.
Thanks, that's all for now.
Bye, talk later.
